subject: Post-call executive recap & next steps - Greenfield Health discovery
messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: michael.torres@greenfieldhealth.com; sara.liu@greenfieldhealth.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & exec summary - Greenfield Health discovery

Michael / Sara - thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap and recommended next steps for your execs/procurement team so we can keep momentum.

Key business outcomes you called out:
- Reduce average time-to-serve patient support inquiries from 48 hours to <6 hours via triage automation and summarization.
- Improve CSAT (target +8 points in 12 months) by surfacing contextual suggestions to care teams.
- Consolidate inference spend across multiple AI pilots to get predictable unit economics with an SLA and auditability.

Primary pain points:
- Current pilot runs across three vendors with variable latency and opaque cost.
- Security/compliance: must support customer-managed keys (KMS) and detailed audit logs for PHI access.
- Procurement prefers a single contract + SOW with a clear timeline to production (Q4 target).

Risks / open items we logged during the call:
1) Data residency & egress requirements for a subset of PHI workflows (Sara to confirm exact regions).
2) SOC2 + HITRUST evidence scope - procurement will want artifact list and time-to-deliver.
3) Cost model: need a committed capacity vs burst pricing proposal to compare to current run-rate.

Recommended immediate next steps:
- Redwood to share: 1) short SOW draft (attached), 2) SOC2 evidence checklist (attached), 3) high-level cost illustration for Dedicated vs Hosted (2 options).
- Michael / Sara to confirm procurement timeline and list of compliance owners (expected by Tue, 5 May).
- Schedule a 30-min follow-up with procurement + security (suggest Wed, 6 May).

Attachments: Greenfield-Discovery-Deck.pdf (summary slides), Redwood-SOW-draft-v1.docx, SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx

If you want, I can also put this into a one-page executive note for your CPO and CIO.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

Subject: Re: Post-call recap & exec summary - Greenfield Health discovery

Thanks Laura - solid summary, appreciate the clear plan. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Procurement path: we prefer a standard SOW + PO route. Our procurement contact will likely want a 60-day negotiation window from SOW receipt. I'll loop them in once you share a version.
2) Security owners: Sara Liu (cc) will own the compliance evaluation; she indicated priority artifacts are SOC2 report, KMS integration docs, and data flow diagrams.
3) Timeline: CIO wants a one-page exec summary for next Wed's leadership sync. If you can send that, I'll present.

Can we also add a quick note on fallback behaviour if a model variant degrades (we need service-level fallback/degeneration policy)?

- Michael Torres

michael.torres@greenfieldhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & exec summary - Greenfield Health discovery

Michael - thanks. Attached is the SOW draft and SOC2 evidence checklist for procurement/security to review. Quick answers inline: 

- Fallback behavior: Redwood supports automated routing policies and compatible model variant fallbacks. We'll include an SLA-backed degradation policy outline in the SOW (automatic fallback to a lower-cost verified variant + alerting to your on-call).
- 60-day negotiation window: we can accommodate that. For Dedicated capacity pricing we'll include a reserved capacity term sheet and an alternate burstable hosted plan for comparison.

Next steps (updated):
- Redwood: send 1-page exec summary + SOW + SOC2 checklist (attached) - by EOD today.
- Michael / Sara: share procurement contact + any specific legal terms redlines to expect (by Tue, 5 May).
- Set procurement/security sync: I’ll propose Wed, 6 May 10:00 AM PT.

Attaching: Redwood-SOW-draft-v1.docx; SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx; Greenfield-Discovery-Deck.pdf

Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap & exec summary - Greenfield Health discovery (exec sponsor recap)

Forwarding the thread and pulling out the items I think leadership should see before the EOD exec sync with their CIO: 

One-line summary:
Greenfield Health (mid-size regional payer/provider) is evaluating Redwood to consolidate AI pilots, reduce latency/cost variability, and satisfy data residency & auditability needs. CIO requested an exec summary for Wed. Procurement wants a standard SOW + 60-day negotiation.

Why this matters (business outcomes):
- Potential multi-year contract if Dedicated reserved capacity accepted (meaning predictable committed revenue).
- Opportunity to expand across triage, summarization, and care-assist use-cases (land-and-expand).

Open risks / asks for leadership help:
- Compliance/artifact turnaround: Sara needs SOC2 artifacts and KMS integration docs quickly - can we prioritize the evidence package delivery (Marissa, can you coordinate with Security/Compliance to confirm timelines and owners)?
- Pricing flexibility: Procurement will push on committed vs burst economics. Aditya, can you prepare a Reserved vs Hosted comparison and a 12-month committed model with optional opt-out clauses?
- Exec one-pager: I’ll draft but would like a quote from Jonas on risk tolerance for early committed deals to include in the note.

Attachments (sent to customer): Greenfield-Discovery-Deck.pdf, Redwood-SOW-draft-v1.docx, SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx

Laura
